body:
I was feeling down and bored so I decided to stop in at a local pub which I frequent. I was the only chap there and the barkeep was about to close when a fellow stopped in and ordered a beer. He was rather creepy with beady eyes and long yellow nails. You could see his breath it was so heavy with stench.  I had seen him before and without too much thought struck up a conversation.
After a couple beers I offered him a ride home. He invited me in and I could see he was in need of connecting with another human being so I accepted. Soon he was handing me a bottle of Dronabinol 5mg. I took two while at his home and didnt notice anything. About an hour later I took another and smoked a bowl of low grade herb and 15mg of the Dronabinol drizzled on top. Now I do smoke a lot of cheeba and this was not the worst ditch weed but the only thing different is it had some color to it. I have smoked a lot of it and it does not get me high at all but a friend had some so we thought it would be a good buffer for our experiment. Between three of us we smoked the bowl and I started to notice the effects as the pipe touched my lips. I knew the 15mg I had taken earlier were kicking in. I popped the pills in my mouth and swallowed the remaining capsule each time I took one.
I started to feel disconnected. I wanted to talk and when I wasnt talking I felt as though I was going to fall down a hole
I wanted to talk and when I wasnt talking I felt as though I was going to fall down a hole
and start spinning with a slight dizzy feeling. I put up with this for about an hour when I decided to head home. I felt like I was driving really high on herb yet I had none of the brain and eye high. Rather strange feeling of satisfaction and disappointment at the same time. When I got home I took two more and laid in bed to do some research on Dronabinol. I read a lame excuse for a blog saying that Dronabinol had EVIL side effects. Well I thought to myself, Damn, I wish I would have read this first. So now I am in bed. I feel good. No worries. Sleepy but not really tired even though it is late. I do feel like if I close my eyes I will go to the beautiful sleepy land.
I do have neuropathy and I havent thought about it during this experience.  I think Dronabinol is a wonderful medication mainly because I can feel certain effects in what I would consider to be a reasonably high dose without getting recreationally high. I would definitely not operate heavy machinery.
